l4_steps.name: Monitor Altéa PSS platform availability
l4_steps.input: Real-time telemetry from Amadeus Altéa hosting environment
l4_steps.output: Availability dashboard; automated alert triggers on SLA breach
l4_steps.kpi: PSS availability ≥99.95% (Amadeus contractual SLA); P1 alert threshold <99.9%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa is hosted on Amadeus shared infrastructure — airline has limited visibility into underlying platform health; alerts may lag actual degradation by 2–3 minutes during peak booking windows

l4_steps.name: Execute daily Altéa module health checks
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa DCS / Amadeus Service Hub
l4_steps.input: Scheduled daily runbook; prior incident tickets; check-in profile inventory
l4_steps.output: Health check report; open defect log with severity classification
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of critical Altéa modules checked daily; zero unchecked P1 defects at day-start
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa DCS health check scripts are not fully automated — manual verification of check-in profile activation is required per airport, creating risk of missed misconfigurations before morning peak operations

l4_steps.name: Assess PSS capacity against booking surge forecast
l4_steps.input: Demand forecast from SkyCAST; current PSS TPS (transactions per second) baseline
l4_steps.output: Capacity risk assessment; Amadeus capacity uplift request if threshold breached
l4_steps.kpi: PSS transaction throughput ≥3,000 TPS at peak; platform headroom ≥20% above forecast peak
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa operates on shared cloud tenancy; requesting capacity uplift requires 72-hour lead time, creating exposure during unexpected IROPS-driven booking surges

l4_steps.name: Log PSS change request in ITSM
l4_steps.input: Business enhancement request or Amadeus scheduled release notification
l4_steps.output: Change request (CR) record with impact assessment template; priority classification
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of PSS changes logged in ServiceNow before implementation; backlog reviewed weekly; zero untracked production changes
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus imposes mandatory maintenance windows for Altéa upgrades (typically 02:00–05:00 local) that may conflict with overnight red-eye operations — airline has limited ability to defer mandatory platform upgrades

l4_steps.name: Conduct PSS change impact assessment
l4_steps.input: Change request record; Altéa module dependency map; active integration inventory
l4_steps.output: Impact assessment document; list of affected downstream systems (DCS, FFP, GDS feeds, CUTE, APIS)
l4_steps.kpi: Impact assessment completed within 3 business days of CR submission; zero unassessed downstream touchpoints at CAB submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS has 40+ integrated touchpoints (GDS, CUTE, APIS, FFP, payment gateway) — full dependency mapping is not maintained in a single CMDB, making impact assessment error-prone and time-consuming

l4_steps.name: Present PSS change to Change Advisory Board
l4_steps.input: Impact assessment; test plan; rollback procedure; maintenance window request
l4_steps.output: CAB approval decision; approved maintenance window slot; emergency change flag if urgent
l4_steps.kpi: CAB first-pass approval rate for standard PSS changes ≥85%; emergency changes <5% of total PSS change volume
l4_steps.pain_point: CAB cycle runs weekly — urgent commercial changes (e.g. new fare class activation before a sale launch) may miss the cycle, forcing the emergency change process which bypasses full regression testing

l4_steps.name: Deploy PSS configuration or patch to production
l4_steps.input: CAB-approved CR record; deployment runbook; rollback script; maintenance window confirmation
l4_steps.output: Deployed configuration or patch; CR status updated to Implemented in ServiceNow
l4_steps.kpi: Deployment success rate ≥98%; rollback execution ≤15 minutes if triggered; zero unplanned outages from PSS deployments
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa configuration deployment does not support blue-green or canary rollout — changes go live for all users simultaneously, making partial rollback impossible without full revert to prior state

l4_steps.name: Execute post-deployment validation and UAT sign-off
l4_steps.role: PSS QA Engineer / Business UAT Lead
l4_steps.input: Deployment confirmation; test scripts; acceptance criteria from business owner
l4_steps.output: UAT sign-off document; CR closed or rollback initiated with RCA
l4_steps.kpi: UAT sign-off within 4 hours of deployment; defect escape rate from PSS releases <2%; rollback decision within 30 minutes of failed gate
l4_steps.pain_point: Post-deployment testing in production relies on live bookings — synthetic transaction testing is limited in Altéa, meaning edge-case itinerary defects (multi-segment codeshares, redemption bookings) only surface with real passenger data

l4_steps.name: Detect and triage PSS service degradation
l4_steps.input: Automated Datadog alert; call centre escalation; airport operations degradation report
l4_steps.output: ServiceNow incident ticket; initial severity classification (P1–P4)
l4_steps.kpi: Mean time to detect (MTTD) ≤5 minutes; P1 incidents triaged within 10 minutes of detection
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa degradation often manifests downstream (slow check-in, booking errors) before the root Altéa API layer raises an alert — false-negative monitoring gaps cause delayed triage during initial incident stages, especially during network-wide IROPS

l4_steps.name: Engage Amadeus emergency support bridge for P1
l4_steps.input: P1 incident ticket; Amadeus SLA escalation threshold (>15 min outage); executive notification list
l4_steps.output: Active Amadeus support bridge; incident war room established; executive notifications dispatched
l4_steps.kpi: Amadeus P1 bridge engagement ≤15 minutes of incident declaration; executive notification ≤20 minutes; Amadeus MTTR for P1 platform incidents ≤60 minutes (SLA)
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa support tiers vary by contract — airlines without Premium SLA tiers experience slower engineer response; SLA contract review is annual and cannot flex responsively during high-impact IROPS events

l4_steps.name: Activate PSS failover or CUTE operational workaround
l4_steps.role: Airport Systems Manager / DCS Operations Lead
l4_steps.input: P1 incident active; failover runbook; CUTE offline check-in procedures; pre-staged passenger manifests
l4_steps.output: Workaround activated (CUTE local mode or paper boarding pass fallback); passenger impact report
l4_steps.kpi: Workaround activation ≤20 minutes from P1 declaration; zero flights missed due to check-in system failure under CUTE local mode
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA CUTE local mode requires pre-staged passenger data synced from PSS — if the outage occurs outside the 90-minute DCS data-push window before departure, CUTE offline mode cannot function and manual processing is required

l4_steps.name: Conduct post-incident review and log problem record
l4_steps.input: Closed P1/P2 incident ticket; incident timeline; Amadeus root cause report
l4_steps.output: Problem record; root cause analysis (RCA) document; permanent fix backlog item in ServiceNow
l4_steps.kpi: RCA completed within 5 business days of P1 resolution; permanent fix scheduled within 30 days for recurring incidents; zero repeat P1s from same root cause within 90 days
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus contractual RCA turnaround for Altéa platform-layer incidents is 10 business days — airline-side problem records cannot be closed until vendor RCA is received, creating SLA breaches in ITSM management reporting

l4_steps.name: Monitor GDS and NDC API message volumes
l4_steps.input: Real-time GDS/NDC feed metrics; booking volume baseline; channel-level transaction logs
l4_steps.output: Integration health dashboard; anomaly alerts per GDS channel (Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus GDS)
l4_steps.kpi: GDS message success rate ≥99.5% per channel; NDC API response time ≤500ms (p95); zero unmonitored distribution channels
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS partners (Sabre GDS, Travelport GDS, Amadeus GDS) operate independent switching infrastructure — airline-side monitoring cannot definitively distinguish PSS degradation from GDS-side issues without per-channel telemetry, leading to mis-attribution of booking failures and delayed escalation

l4_steps.name: Validate APIS/PNR submission to government systems
l4_steps.role: Government Compliance Analyst / PSS Data Engineer
l4_steps.input: Booked PNR data; departure manifest; CBP/TSA APIS API endpoints; schedule change notifications
l4_steps.output: APIS transmission confirmation log; error report for failed or incomplete submissions
l4_steps.kpi: APIS advance notification success rate ≥99.9% (US CBP mandate); failed submissions resolved ≥4 hours before scheduled departure
l4_steps.pain_point: US CBP requires APIS transmission ≥60 minutes before departure for international flights — last-minute schedule changes or codeshare segment additions can break APIS data completeness, triggering regulatory penalties up to $5,000 per violation

l4_steps.name: Maintain PSS-to-CUTE/CUSS airport integration
l4_steps.input: Check-in agent workstation logs; CUTE connectivity reports; DCS profile configuration
l4_steps.output: Updated CUTE profile configuration; resolved connectivity tickets; DCS sync confirmation
l4_steps.kpi: CUTE check-in uptime ≥99.8% across all outstations; DCS profile sync errors <0.1% of daily transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline operates at 100+ airports, each with varying CUTE software versions and local airport IT ownership — PSS DCS profile updates do not auto-propagate to all CUTE endpoints simultaneously, creating version drift that causes check-in failures during Altéa upgrades

l4_steps.name: Execute quarterly PCI-DSS scope review for PSS
l4_steps.system: Qualys / Amadeus Altéa Payment Gateway Integration
l4_steps.input: PCI-DSS v4.0 assessment checklist; PSS payment processing scope diagram; prior audit findings
l4_steps.output: PCI scope review report; remediation backlog items; updated scope diagram
l4_steps.kpi: PCI-DSS assessment completed quarterly; zero P1 findings at annual QSA audit; tokenization coverage ≥100% of card-present transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa integrates with multiple payment processors (Worldpay, Adyen) via PSS middleware — PCI scope boundaries shift with each integration update, and Amadeus does not consistently publish advance notice of scope-impacting Altéa upgrades

l4_steps.name: Conduct PSS user access recertification
l4_steps.role: IT Security Analyst / PSS Access Control Owner
l4_steps.input: Quarterly access review schedule; Altéa role inventory; leaver/mover report from SAP SuccessFactors
l4_steps.output: Recertified access matrix; deprovisioned orphaned accounts; audit evidence package for SOX
l4_steps.kpi: Access review completed within 10 business days of cycle start; orphaned account remediation ≤24 hours of identification; privileged Altéa accounts reviewed monthly
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa user provisioning is managed in a separate identity silo from corporate Azure AD — SSO federation is partial, meaning leavers deprovisioned in Okta may retain active Altéa sessions until manual sync runs, creating SOX and GDPR compliance exposure
